project_identity.content_id: not safely recoverable as an arbitrary product input

assigned_staff.identity: clone-vector index, not recovered runtime Staff.id, StaffData.id, or external agent ID

staff_initialization: Develop/DevelopForm sets draw x/y and seb fields
OnStartStep sets frame2_=0, stepFinished_=false and ordinarily enters developState_=3
flags_and_state: Staff.state==12 is the native UpdateDevelop dispatch
developState_ is a separate sub-state domain
enemy interruption uses developStateBackup_ and temporary developState_=10
payload_result: Original Develop payload is a game-specific proposal/step/clone context. It is not used as an external product task payload.
